create.name: Hari-kirtana das
create.bio:
Hari-kirtana das teaches yoga philosophy from within the bhakti-yoga tradition, in which he trained by learning from teachers who had themselves received the teachings in a line of transmission. He began studying postures, meditation and philosophy in his teens and spent his early twenties living in yoga ashrams and spiritual communities, later working for large corporations and technology start-ups before returning to teaching. He completed 800 hours of Jivamukti teacher certification in New York and has taught yoga and meditation classes for well over a decade, as well as serving on the faculty of many teacher trainings.

His particular interest is helping yoga teachers understand the tradition as one connected body of thought, so that they can bring texts such as the Bhagavad Gita and the Yoga Sutras into their classes with accuracy and confidence. He describes his approach as reading the modern world through yoga philosophy rather than the reverse. He offers one-to-one mentoring for teachers, recorded workshops on themes such as the koshas and chakras and mantra meditation, short e-books, and a free monthly online conversation. He is the author of Journey Into the Bhagavad Gita and In Search of the Highest Truth, a collection of essays and dialogues, and has also led kirtan at yoga studios around Washington, DC.

books.title: In Search of the Highest Truth: Adventures in Yoga Philosophy
books.author: Hari-kirtana das
books.description: Essays and conversations on the big questions yoga philosophy takes up, from consciousness and free will to meaning, faith and the nature of reality. Written for practitioners who want to see how the tradition's ideas apply to life today.

courses.title: Yoga Teacher Mentorship
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring for working yoga teachers, shaped around each teacher's own classes and goals rather than a fixed syllabus. It begins with a free introductory call.

courses.title: Three Pillars of Yoga: Yoga Sutras in Practice
courses.description: A recorded workshop on three foundational practices from the Yoga Sutras and how they support each other in a lasting spiritual practice. Registered for Yoga Alliance continuing education.

courses.title: Yoga’s Inner Dynamics: Koshas and Chakras in Yoga Practice
courses.description: A recorded workshop explaining the layered model of the self in the koshas and chakras, and what it says about how yoga practice works on body, mind and awareness.

courses.title: How to Connect Spiritual Ideas to Real Life
courses.description: A recorded workshop on how yoga's core ideas link to one another and to everyday choices. Aimed at teachers and students who want a clearer overall map of the tradition.

courses.title: Practical Strategies for Decoding Yoga Wisdom Texts
courses.description: A recorded workshop with practical ways to approach traditional yoga texts without getting lost, so their teachings become easier to follow and use.

courses.title: Meditation Beyond Mindfulness: Practice Bundle
courses.description: A recorded workshop and practice set on mantra meditation, using sacred sound as a focus alongside or beyond mindfulness practice.

courses.title: Glossary of Sanskrit Philosophical Terms
courses.description: An e-book of more than a hundred Sanskrit terms from yoga philosophy with short definitions, grouped by theme, plus a guide to pronunciation.

free_resources.title: Free chapter: Journey Into the Bhagavad Gita
free_resources.description: A sample chapter from his guide to the Bhagavad Gita, sent free on sign-up. It introduces his way of explaining the Gita's teaching on action, purpose and devotion.

free_resources.title: Free chapter: In Search of the Highest Truth
free_resources.description: A free sample chapter from his book of essays on yoga philosophy and life's big questions, available by email sign-up.
